question: Which pair of numbers does not have a product equal to \(36?\)
solution:
Two factors with opposite signs have a negative product. In choice C,
\[\frac12\cdot(-72)=-36,\]
which is not \(36\). Checking the other choices gives
\[(-4)(-9)=36,\qquad(-3)(-12)=36,\]
\[1\cdot36=36,\qquad\frac32\cdot24=36.\]
Thus the required pair is \(\{\frac12,-72\}\), choice \(\mathrm C\).
